RaggieSoft StoreTrainer v1.0 (Win32 Retro PC Game & Trainer Manager)

RaggieSoft StoreTrainer (TStore.exe) is a 100% hand-written (pre-AI, 2018–2020) Win32 desktop utility authored by Michael P. Ragsdale in Visual Basic 6.0 (TStore.vbp) inside a Windows 2000 Professional SP4 virtual machine. It indexes, stores, and launches classic and modern PC games alongside their associated game trainers (cheat utilities) and custom command-line switches across every desktop release of Windows from Windows 95 through Windows 11.

💾 Download Official Installer: tssetup100.exe (Win95–Win11) 🔍 Inspect VB6 & .NET Source Code (18 Files) → 📦 Inspect NSIS Wizard95 Installer Scripts →

Why StoreTrainer Was Built (2018–2020)

Many classic 1990s and 2000s PC games require either specific command-line switches (such as resolution overrides, -windowed, or mod directory flags) or companion memory-resident game trainers that must be launched in the proper working directory before or alongside the game executable.

Built inside a Windows 2000 Professional SP4 VM using pure Win32 API calls (shell32.dll ShellExecuteA, comdlg32.dll GetOpenFileNameA, and SHBrowseForFolder) without heavy third-party ActiveX/OCX dependencies, StoreTrainer runs natively on a Pentium-era Windows 95/98 retro rig just as cleanly as on a modern Windows 11 workstation.

Zero-Database .sfile Flat-File Specification

True to RaggieSoft's zero-database philosophy, StoreTrainer stores each game profile as a human-readable 6-line sequential text file (<GameName>.sfile) alongside StoreTrainer.cfg: 

Line 1: GameName     (Display title in the StoreTrainer list)
Line 2: GameFile     (Full path to the game .exe binary)
Line 3: GameArgs     (Optional command-line switches for the game)
Line 4: TrainerFile  (Full path to the companion trainer .exe, or empty)
Line 5: TrainerArgs  (Optional command-line switches for the trainer)
Line 6: GamePath     (Working directory passed to ShellExecuteA)
Line 7: TrainerPath  (Trainer working directory passed to ShellExecuteA)

Verified Windows Operating System Compatibility Matrix

Operating System Family Supported Releases Architecture & Runtime Notes
Windows 9x (Win32) Windows 95, Windows 98, Windows 98 SE, Windows ME Verified via NSIS WinVer.nsh (AtLeastWin95); deploys msvbvm60.dll if absent.
Windows NT Classic Windows NT 4.0, Windows 2000 Professional SP4, Windows XP Primary Development Environment: Built & compiled inside Windows 2000 Professional SP4.
Modern Windows NT (x86/x64) Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11 Runs seamlessly via WOW64 (TStore.exe VB6) or natively via the included TStore.NET port.
